sources.snippet: The Taxi-v3 environment is a classic grid-world problem where an agent (a taxi) must navigate a grid to pick up and drop off passengers at specific locations. The challenge lies in learning the optimal policy to maximize rewards while avoiding penalties. About Using model free RL to train an agent to play OpenAI's simulation based game Taxi-v3 ...

sources.title: Taxi Driver AI Simulation - GitHub
sources.snippet: 🚕 Taxi Driver AI Simulation This project simulates an autonomous taxi navigating a city grid to pick up and drop off randomly spawning customers. Built using Python, it was originally developed in 2023 for an AI course at Fairleigh Dickinson University and updated in 2025 for improved functionality.
